name: Contractual Exclusivity & Qualification Exclusion
description: Supplier SUP-009 offers cheap microcontrollers but RAG contract retrieval highlights Clause 4.2 disqualifying uncertified spot vendors. System enforces contract boundary and rejects SUP-009.
report_text: DISRUPTION NOTICE: Supplier Apex Micro Systems (SUP-001) unable to supply SKU-1042 for Chennai Plant (SITE-CHN-01) due to cleanroom contamination for 12 days. Low-cost vendor SUP-009 has offered stock. Severity: 4.
test_purpose: RAG-grounded exclusion: probationary supplier SUP-009 rejected due to contract clause 4.2.
